meta.author: Andrew Fisher
meta.what: Footprint catalogue from the drawings, by item type
meta.scale: 1:2000 title block, 0.705556 m per pt; D022/D023/D024/D025 and K220 are on the same base (identical 1114 cyan 3.8 x 0.6 m concrete-barrier pieces) so the same factor applies
meta.rule: Every size cites a drawing measurement, a document line or the record; "size to confirm" where none exists.
meta.spread_fields: median/min/max/p10/p90/sd in metres over the instances counted in n_instances

Building 6m.door_rule: One door on a LONG side, opening outward (legend PORTABLE BUILDINGS: quarter-circle swing + leaf). Door centre about a quarter of the way along that side (0.23-0.25 of the edge from the nearer end, about 1.4 m in on a 6 m unit); swing radius 0.78 m. Which long side, and which end, is per unit: read it from the unit's own traced door (v9.15 door.faces).

sources.how_measured: v9.15 tracing (shapes_v915.json): outline = the PDF vector path itself at the tagged reference; length/width = mean of opposite edges of the 4-vertex path x 0.705556 m/pt (title block 1:2000); recomputed here from poly_pt, not the rounded size_m; refs: AA, CP1, HRP, P05, P06, P08, P09, P36, P37, P38, P39, P41, P42, P44, P45, P54, P58, P62, P63, P65, P66, P67, P69
